Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental logical error in the initial analysis. The task asks "Which film has the director died first," meaning the director who died at the earlier date in time. The Planner incorrectly concluded in the final step that "Stig Olin died first" because 2008 is numerically greater than 1961. In chronological terms, 1961 (George Melford) is earlier than 2008 (Stig Olin), so George Melford died first. The Planner confused the concept of "first" (earliest in time) with "greater number" (later in time). This error occurred in the very first step of the conversation when the Planner formulated the understanding and approach, and was compounded in the final decision step where the comparison was performed incorrectly.
